test_case.test_name: Parameterized InfiniBand RC latency and write-bandwidth paired perftest validation
test_case.purpose: Measure repeatable RC latency and RDMA write bandwidth between two approved IB endpoints and compare both result families with their NIC/fabric specification.
required_package: SUT/peer HCA/device/port/GID/LID/IPoIB/fabric roles and isolated path
Latency/BW, variance, retry/error/counter and host-health thresholds
test_case.test_command: Capture both endpoints, HCA/port/GID/LID/IPoIB/link and counters; load only approved modules and verify peer reachability; run ibv_rc_pingpong server/client with explicit peer for the bound repetitions and retain all latency results; rebaseline, then run ib_write_bw server/client with explicit peer/profile and retain all bandwidth results; calculate the approved averages, capture counters/health, stop exact processes and restore module/network state.
test_case.expected_result: Both RC latency and write-bandwidth profiles complete repeatably over the designated IB path, meet their independent thresholds and leave fabric/endpoints healthy with acceptable counter deltas.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires both named tests, exact paired topology/profile, every raw run plus approved average and all thresholds. Peerless/local execution, bandwidth-only coverage, missing threshold or fabric regression is BLOCKED/FAIL.
safety_gate: Confirm isolated InfiniBand path, distinct endpoints and exact HCA/port mapping.
Authorize module/IPoIB changes and preserve prior state.
Abort on link flap, counter storm, production impact or CPU/thermal limit.
Rebaseline between latency and bandwidth phases; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Tool/module identities and before/after network state
All paired ibv_rc_pingpong runs and latency averages
All paired ib_write_bw runs and bandwidth averages
IB counters, threshold comparison, cleanup and final health
test_case.recovery: On module/path/link/host fault, stop exact test processes, preserve evidence, restore prior IPoIB/module/network state and verify both endpoints/fabric; do not substitute Ethernet or an optional transport mode.
